```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = FALSE)
```

`agriGLMflow` follows a design-first rule: the experimental unit and dependence structure are defined before selecting a response family. Automated choices are auditable and are not based solely on P values or the smallest information criterion.

Repeated observations within a plot are not independent replicates.

```{r}
data(agri_repeated)
d <- agri_design(agri_repeated,"repeated",treatment="treatment",
  subject="plot",time="time",block="block",covariance="independence")
```

The design stores the repeated-measures unit and time variable. AR(1) structures can be requested for compatible glmmTMB models. Cross-validation must split by plot, not individual observations, to avoid leakage.
